passes.notes: Answer A builds the process around the practice manager and the vet only. It adds a review timeout so work keeps moving when the vet is slow to reply, and it covers holiday hours and stale holiday notices directly. It also deals with existing blog posts by adding reviewed dates and retiring posts nobody can vouch for. Answer B is solid on holiday hours and limiting who can edit, but it adds an editor role, presents turnaround times and clinic managers as settled facts, and leaves out the existing blog content.

B builds the whole workflow around the practice manager and the vet. It deals with existing blog posts by adding review dates, re-checking them and retiring any post no one can vouch for, and it ends with a concrete 'this week' list.
